purpose: Eliminate the local three-way disjunction from the complementary-C4 carrier. Over GF(3), a coordinate square is the 0/1 indicator of being nonzero, so ONE_NONZERO_3 is exactly one quadratic sphere equation. Consequently fixed-C4 Hamiltonian 3-colourability becomes a highly structured multivariate-quadratic system over GF(3).

field_identity.fact: For z in GF(3), z^2=0 iff z=0 and z^2=1 iff z is nonzero.
field_identity.theorem: For y=(y1,y2,y3) in GF(3)^3, exactly one coordinate is nonzero iff y1^2+y2^2+y3^2=1.
field_identity.proof: The left side of the equation is the number of nonzero coordinates reduced modulo 3. For three coordinates that number is in {0,1,2,3}, whose residues are {0,1,2,0}; residue 1 occurs only for Hamming weight one.

C4_translation.arc_space: Let a=(a1,a2,a3,a4) be the four complementary-C4 arc tensions with sum a_i=0.
C4_translation.linear_change: Use v5.4 coordinates y1=-(a1+a2), y2=-(a1+a3), y3=-(a1+a4).
C4_translation.equivalence: The C4 is properly coloured iff y1^2+y2^2+y3^2=1 in GF(3).
C4_translation.no_case_split: This single quadratic equation represents all six proper C4 sign states exactly.

Hamiltonian_MQ_system.variables: One t_i in GF(3) for every oriented Hamiltonian edge.
Hamiltonian_MQ_system.arc_forms: Every C4 arc tension a_j is a consecutive-interval GF(3) linear form in t. Therefore every projective coordinate y_{T,r}=ell_{T,r}^T t is linear in t.
Hamiltonian_MQ_system.C4_equation: For every complementary C4 T, sum_{r=1}^3 (ell_{T,r}^T t)^2=1.
Hamiltonian_MQ_system.main_equivalence: A fixed-C4 4-regular Hamiltonian graph is 3-colourable iff this MQ system has a solution t in GF(3)^n. Vertex colours reconstruct by prefix integration from one fixed root colour.
Hamiltonian_MQ_system.size: The system has O(n) variables/equations and a polynomial sparse interval description; no sign-state enumeration is present.

positive: The local C4 hard atom is one quadratic equation, not an irreducible six-way case distinction.
All nonzero Hamiltonian-edge constraints are also quadratic equations t_i^2=1, so the complete source is an equality-only GF(3) system.
Quadratic forms can be lifted linearly to second moments, isolating the next bottleneck as global rank-one consistency.
firewall: General MQ over GF(3) is not a licensed polynomial subroutine; this artifact relies on the special interval/Hamiltonian structure for any future algorithm.
Linearizing monomials t_i t_j without enforcing their rank-one/product consistency is only a relaxation and cannot be promoted to an exact solver.
The fixed-C4 Hamiltonian source remains NP-hard.

next_target.directive: Lift t to a symmetric moment matrix X=t t^T (or z z^T with z=(1,t)). Express every edge-square, cycle-closure and C4 quadratic constraint linearly in X. Determine whether the special interval coefficient matrices force rank one automatically, admit a polynomial rank-reduction theorem, or have an explicit higher-rank false-positive family. Do not treat the linear relaxation as exact without a rank-one proof.
